title: Fire-Boltt Phoenix Air Smart Watch 1.26” Round Display, Rotating Button, Wireless Charging, Ultra Lightweight Metal Body, Bluetooth Calling, Smartwatch with Silicone & Mesh Steel Straps Carbon Black
bullets: 1.26” Small Display Smartwatch | Perfect for Thin Wrists - The Fire-Boltt Phoenix Air is designed with a compact 1.26-inch round display, making it the ideal smartwatch for women, girls, and users with smaller wrist sizes. A stylish choice for those who prefer a lightweight and elegant smartwatch.

Ultra Lightweight & Premium Metal Body Design - Crafted with a durable metal body and an ultra-lightweight build, Phoenix Air delivers premium comfort for all-day wear, perfect as a daily girls smartwatch with a modern luxury feel.

Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch with Built-in Mic & Speaker - Stay connected wherever you go with Bluetooth calling support, powered by an in-built microphone and speaker. Make and receive calls directly from your wrist without reaching for your phone.
Rotating Button Crown for Smooth Navigation - Enjoy effortless control with the stylish rotating button, designed for easy scrolling, quick access, and a premium smartwatch experience.
Wireless Charging Smart Watch | Hassle-Free Power - Phoenix Air supports wireless charging, making it convenient and clutter-free to power up your smartwatch anytime.

120+ Exercise Modes Fitness Smartwatch for Active Lifestyles - Track your workouts with 120+ exercise modes, covering walking, running, yoga, gym workouts, cycling, dance, and more — a complete fitness smartwatch for women and men.

Beautiful Colors + Silicone & Mesh Stainless Steel Strap Options - Choose from stunning color variants and premium strap styles, including soft silicone straps for comfort and elegant mesh stainless steel straps for a classy everyday look.
Smart Notifications for Everyday Convenience - Get instant smart notifications for calls, WhatsApp, messages, and app alerts, keeping you updated throughout the day.
